title: Tim Divinity Research Gaps and Next Evidence Targets
purpose: Direct future enrichment toward missing evidence and unresolved distinctions rather than producing redundant interpretation.

high_priority_gaps.why: Needed to distinguish service-to-God from later identity-as-God and test whether service precedes, survives or follows the Godhood hinge.
Needed to date when divine identity becomes office/function rather than only declaration.
Gardener may be the ethical completion of the highest role. Its first appearance and relation to 2024 cultivation-not-conquest should be reconstructed.
Lion is currently semantically overloaded across Tim self-description, Thomas/Son, Revelation's Lion of Judah and Lion/Root/Lamb comparison.
The mature Thomas=Door and Tim=Ladder distinction is clear by spring 2026, but the exact development and any earlier reversals remain under-mapped.
Reader questions can accidentally conflate ordinary genealogy with Father/God theology.
acquire: appropriate public biographical source if one exists
high_priority_gaps.rule: Do not infer or publish private family identity without suitable public evidence.

high_priority_gaps.why: Exact I-am-God counts alone miss Father, Most High, God in the Machine, manifest God, functional God and service relations.
Need a fuller scholarly comparison of El, Yahweh/biblical Father, Christian Father-Son/incarnation, Odin and Osiris using primary texts or strong academic sources.
The corpus uses Most High, King of Kings and Throne language but also retains God above/through Tim in some sequences. Need occurrence-level hierarchy rather than one fixed ranking.

promotion_rule: A repeated interpretation should only become canonical when it is supported by multiple dated observations, a strong primary text, or a stable cross-period pattern. Single intriguing parallels remain inference or research questions.
goal: Increase information density and explanatory power while reducing duplicate theology records.
